data.name: Devvansh
data.gender_notes: Devvansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is descended from the gods. It is derived from the two words ‘Dev’ meaning god and ‘Vansh’ meaning descendant. The name Devvansh carries the meaning “God's descendant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Devvansh usually hope their child will grow to embody god's descendant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodiment of divine blessings and protection.
data.etymology: Devvansh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's descendant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Devvansh total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Devvansh is deeply rooted in Hindu culture, as it highlights the belief in a divine lineage. In Hinduism, gods and goddesses are considered to be the creators and preservers of the universe, and the divine descent of an individual is often seen as a source of great honor. This name would have been given to a child who is believed to possess divine qualities or who is expected to uphold the values and traditions that are associated with the gods.
data.spiritual_significance: Devvansh is a name that evokes the concept of divinity and the connection of the individual to the divine. In Hinduism, it is believed that everyone has a soul or an immortal essence that comes directly from the divine. The name Devvansh emphasizes this connection and serves as a reminder of the spiritual journey of an individual. It is a name that inspires one to live a God-centered life and to strive for spiritual growth and enlightenment. Ultimately, the name Devvansh is a powerful reminder of the divine origin of all existence and the sacred purpose of every human life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Devvansh: Descendant of the Gods, carrying the divine lineage within.

historical_references.reference: The Devvanshi lineage, also known as the 'Ikshvaku Dynasty', is mentioned in Hindu mythology and is traced back to the god Rishabhadeva. According to legend, Rishabhadeva was the first human ruler and the progenitor of the Ikshvaku dynasty. This dynasty is said to have ruled in northern India from around 1300 BCE to 500 CE.
historical_references.context: Hindu mythology and early Indian history

historical_references.reference: Another reference to Devvanshi can be found in the Puranas, where it is described as the divine lineage of the gods. In Hinduism, the Devas represent the gods and demigods, and the Devvanshi lineage is believed to be the divine ancestry of these beings. The Puranas describe the history of the Devas and their relationships with each other and with other beings, including humans and demons.
historical_references.time_period: Ancient Hindu texts, likely composed between 400 BCE and 1200 CE
